isolated_tests: Guests and administrators cannot delete another owner’s subject
Failed second file move and failed database commit restore all originals and preferences
Single-book deletion retains the subject and preference
Encoded subject names and no automatic deletion retries
limits: Library write serialization is local to one API process.

Physical-device and Safari/Firefox acceptance remain open.
